title: Global attractors and fast-slow reduction for finite-state actor-critic mean dynamics
summary: When a learning algorithm reshapes the data distribution it trains on, the long-run behavior depends on the joint evolution of the policy, the value estimate, and the data distribution. We study finite-state actor-critic mean dynamics on the enlarged phase space $(θ,w,μ)$, where $θ$ is the actor parameter, $w$ is an auxiliary critic state, and $μ$ is a state-law variable (the distribution over states induced by the current policy).
